note: Project 6 of the documented example program. The project matrix (docs/rtl-analyzer-v3/rtl-ui-catalog.json) defines no workspace-specific cases, so this slice reuses LAYOUT-001 (margin) in a multi-app Nx workspace with a shared library; the workspace shape, shared/app-specific/control split and all outcomes are this slice's own. Variants en-ltr and ar-rtl, desktop viewport, pointer input. Expectations were written BEFORE the first install, build or scan.

workspace.library: libs/ui (@ws/ui, source-consumed through a Vite alias and tsconfig paths)
workspace.tooling: npm, nx 23.3.0 (nx:run-commands targets only, no Nx Vite plugin), Vite 6, React 19, CSS Modules with generateScopedName [local]

cases.scenario: Shared badge, physical margin between the heading text and the badge

expectedBrowser.ltr: Badge sits 8 px to the right of the heading text (computed margin-left 8px, margin-right 0).
expectedBrowser.rtl: Intended: 8 px gap on the left of the badge (after the Arabic text). Expected DEFECT: computed margin-left 8px, margin-right 0, so the badge touches the Arabic text on its right side (0 px gap) and has 8 px of dead space on its left. Same defect in BOTH apps.

cases.expectedDetection: RTL.CSS.PHYSICAL on libs/ui/src/StatusBadge.module.css (path under libs/, not under an app). One finding, not two (the file is scanned once).
cases.expectedTransformation: Supported candidate margin-inline-start: 8px (simple class selector). Preview targets: .badge in both storefront and admin (mapping lists both routes); After expected to fix both apps.

expectedBrowser.ltr: 12 px gap on the right of the bold refund label.
expectedBrowser.rtl: Intended: 12 px on the end side (left in RTL). Expected DEFECT: gap stays on the right (margin-right 12px, margin-left 0), so the note touches the label.

cases.expectedDetection: RTL.CSS.PHYSICAL on apps/admin/src/Admin.module.css only; nothing on the storefront for this case.
cases.expectedTransformation: Supported candidate margin-inline-end: 12px; preview in admin only (storefront has no such element).

cases.assignment: libs/ui/src/InfoCard.module.css (logical padding, border-inline-start, margin-block-end) and apps/storefront/src/Storefront.module.css (all logical or symmetric)
cases.scenario: Clean control: shared card and storefront promo use logical properties only

expectedBrowser.ltr: Card accent border on the left; promo bar on the left.
expectedBrowser.rtl: Card accent border and promo bar on the right; no defect.

cases.expectedDetection: No findings in InfoCard.module.css, Storefront.module.css, or Admin.module.css other than .refundNote.

expectedDiagnostics: RTL.DOCUMENT.INITIAL (Info) on each app index.html: possible
RTL.RUNTIME.DIRECTION_UNKNOWN (Minor) on each App.tsx: possible, as in earlier examples
expectedScanCompleteness: complete: true. Uncertain: whether discovery with scanRoots [apps, libs] also treats libs/ui/project.json specially.

expectedPreview.original: Original renders for WSI-SHARED-01 in storefront and in admin, and for WSI-APP-01 in admin. Risk: startupScript 'dev:storefront' runs `npm run dev:storefront -- --config ... --port ...`, which goes through `nx run storefront:dev --`; Nx may not forward the extra flags to the run-commands command (my target hardcodes them, so a duplicate --port/--config is possible) or may not exit with the child's process group semantics. If Nx startup fails, record the exact error.
expectedPreview.after: After renders via a candidate of margin-inline-start: 8px in the shared library; the isolated candidate runtime must resolve @ws/ui and compile libs/ui from the candidate copy. Risk: shared-library path may not be inside the candidate project root mapping.

expectedReview: All decisions pending; source hashes unchanged before/after the review.

attempt1.scan: complete: true; 15 files scanned, 5 skipped (project.json x3, vite.config.mjs x2); 2 actionable RTL.CSS.PHYSICAL (libs/ui/src/StatusBadge.module.css:3 margin-left: 8px; apps/admin/src/Admin.module.css:7 margin-right: 12px) plus RTL.DOCUMENT.INITIAL x2 and RTL.RUNTIME.DIRECTION_UNKNOWN x2. Matches expectedActionable. Attribution: the admin finding has applications ["admin"]; the shared libs/ui finding has applications [] (no app attribution).
attempt1.browser: Both Nx dev servers started (npm run dev:storefront / dev:admin). WSI-SHARED-01 matched in both apps (LTR gap 8 px; RTL gap 0 px, margin-left 8px, margin-right 0). WSI-OK-01 matched (card border left in LTR, right in RTL; promo likewise). WSI-APP-01 did NOT match the recorded expectation: with margin-right: 12px on the note, LTR gap between label and note is 0 px and RTL gap is 12 px (the reverse of what was written). The fixture was wrong (a right margin on the trailing element is not a gap after the label).
attempt1.action: Fixture changed to margin-left: 12px (leading gap, the intended physical-side defect) and attempt2Expectations written before the rescan.
